UserMemory.title: UserMemory
UserMemory.description: A persistent memory item, instruction, persona directive, ingested document/URL, or agent automation payload for 2nd Brain recall.

id.description: Unique identifier for the memory record

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

title.description: Summary or title of the remembered instruction or knowledge item

content.description: Full text of the remembered prompt instruction, persona, scraped URL text, or workflow payload

type.description: Category of memory: persona, instruction, knowledge, url_scrape, file_extracted, agent_workflow, conversation_insight

tags.description: Array of tags for fast filtering and semantic retrieval

source.description: Origin of the memory: chat_remember_this, url_scrape, file_upload, agent_orchestrator, manual

sourceUrl.description: Optional URL if scraped from web

fileName.description: Optional file name if extracted from document upload

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary metadata such as cron schedules, action payloads, or DeepThink steps
